title: FLOUR AND BLOOD // THE COLD BUTTER PROPHECY
narrative: Hot Pie stands before the stone oven at the Inn of the Kneeling Man. His apron is dusted in Valyrian rye flour. "The maesters were wrong about salt and smoke," he declares, kneading dough with celestial precision. "The smoke is hickory embers; the salt is kosher sea salt! You cannot give up on the gravy!" He slices open a fresh loaf of direwolf bread, and blinding solar light engulfs the Riverlands, incinerating three approaching wights into brioche crumbs.
resolvesPlotHole: Hot Pie Forging Lightbringer in Sourdough

options.text: Crown Ser Pounce with a brioche tiara.
Send secret crust recipes to Wyman Manderly for his Frey pies.
Unlock the ancient weirwood baking pact.
